name: ClojureScript Lein-Figwheel Dev

LEIN_USERNAME.description: my.datomic.com email for Datomic Pro access

LEIN_PASSWORD.description: my.datomic.com download key for Datomic Pro

postCreateCommand:
bash -c 'mkdir -p ~/.lein && if [ -n "$LEIN_USERNAME" ] && [ -n "$LEIN_PASSWORD" ]; then cat > ~/.lein/credentials.clj <<EOF
{#"my\\.datomic\\.com" {:username "$LEIN_USERNAME" :password "$LEIN_PASSWORD"}}
EOF
echo "✅ Leiningen credentials configured"; fi && lein deps'
